project_type: Static-export marketing/commerce website (React 19 + Next 16, trailingSlash) with a Python 3.12 AWS Amplify/Lambda backend (headless Wix commerce + Razorpay). Multi-brand WECARE.DIGITAL site.
build_system: npm (Node v22) for frontend static export; Python via .venv (python3.12) for backend. conftest.py requires Python >=3.12.
test_framework: Frontend: vitest (src/**/*.test.tsx, src/test/*). Backend: pytest with tests/ driving real handlers against an in-memory DynamoDB fake (tests/crm_fake_dynamo.py) and stubbed provider readback. TypeScript typecheck via tsc --noEmit.
build_command: npm run build (static export, ~1407 sitemap URLs; fetches remote blog content and can transiently fail on an upstream 429 during /post/[slug] export - re-run to confirm exit 0; do NOT weaken the build's fail-hard safety).
test_command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q  &&  npx tsc --noEmit  &&  npx vitest run
verification_instructions: Known-good exact-tree baseline on base 51445762 (must stay green, report true counts after changes): pytest ~5757 passed/1 skipped; npx tsc --noEmit exit 0; npx vitest run ~684 passed; npm run build exit 0 (~1407 sitemap URLs). New frontend behavior gets real vitest coverage; new payment/contribution backend code gets real pytest coverage driving the actual handlers against tests/crm_fake_dynamo.py with stubbed provider readback. Payment code must additionally have revert-checks (a test that fails if the security guard is reverted).
snapshot_or_generated_files: config/public-pages.json `pages` array is GENERATED: run `node scripts/generate-public-pages.js` after adding a public route (and group), and `node scripts/generate-public-pages.js --check` fails in CI if stale. A new public route with no `group` is a hard build failure. The groups[] array (hand-written) is where the 'Perks' group id/title is declared. llms.txt / llms-full.txt derive from it at build time.
setup_instructions: Dependencies already installed in sandbox (node_modules present, .venv present). If reinstalling: `npm ci` and `.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements-dev.txt`.
environment_constraints: Network OPEN_INTERNET (npm/PyPI/official Wix+Razorpay docs reachable). AWS: NO credentials in this sandbox (aws sts get-caller-identity fails; no ~/.aws). So NO deploy, NO live Wix/Razorpay calls, NO S3/DynamoDB, NO live verification. Any live AWS key pasted earlier MUST NOT be used/stored/echoed. Anything needing AWS/Wix-live is delivered as source + tests + a precise runbook and reported BLOCKED-ON-ENVIRONMENT, never executed or faked.
contribution_requirements: git-workflow.md normally mandates a single branch `stack`; the USER EXPLICITLY OVERRODE this for THIS task: commit ALL work to the already-checked-out branch `feature/customer-experience-upgrade` (base SHA 51445762 == origin/stack). Do NOT commit to stack, do NOT push, do NOT open a PR. Explicit-path staging only (never git add -A); no force/reset/history rewrite. .kiro/steering/00-current-owner-overrides.md is highest priority but does not conflict with this task's scope. PAYMENT-AUDIT-REPORT.md and secret-handling.md govern payment/secret rules.

key_patterns.public_page_registration: A public route requires THREE lists in step or it serves the staff sign-in shell at HTTP 200 (invisible 404): (1) PUBLIC_PAGE_META in src/pages/_app.tsx (render allowlist + schema; name/description), OR for pages owning their own <head> the isPublic/isContentPublic router.pathname chain; (2) PUBLIC_EXACT in scripts/generate-sitemap.js (crawl allowlist); (3) config/public-pages.json pages[] (generated) + a groups[] entry for any new group. src/test/PublicRouteRegistration.test.ts, PublicAiSurface.test.ts and StructuredDataService.test.ts enforce agreement. trailingSlash is on, so hrefs keep trailing slashes and `match` is the slashless form.
key_patterns.page_shape: Thin page files under src/pages/*.tsx. Marketing/service pages reuse RotatingHero (hero band) OR components/PageTopBand.tsx (the shared top band used by cart/account/checkout/shop). Copy for the request/product pages lives as data in src/content/customerservice.ts and src/content/products.ts rendered by components/ProductPage.tsx. Styling via scoped styled-jsx with a page-specific class prefix; reuse the four tint/dot colour pairs; section h2 is the 700 rung. Plain <a> (not next/link) for cross-page links because styled-jsx does not scope composite components.
key_patterns.nav_source: src/components/Header.tsx COLUMNS: NavColumn[] is the customer-facing dropdown nav (groups have a `heading` and `links` with {label, href, match}). Current group headings: '' (Home/Shop), 'Products', 'Requests', 'Work with us', 'Contact', 'Legal Stuff'. The 'Requests' group currently holds Orders, Submit Request, Request Amendment, Drop Docs, Vault, Leave Review. Header.test.tsx asserts the row set. Footer.tsx deliberately has NO Terms/Privacy/Contact (those live in the header dropdown). src/config/navigation.ts is the INTERNAL /workspace sidebar (NOT customer nav) - do not confuse the two.
key_patterns.customerservice_label_rule: Section 1: the customer-facing group label must be 'Request' and must NEVER read 'Get Help'/'Customer-Service'/'Selfservice'/'Help Hub'. The current customer label is already 'Requests' (not any banned word). Do NOT globally rename internal `customerservice` identifiers, workspace routes, provider templates, APIs, config/public-pages.json group id 'customerservice', or historical integration ids - migration-unsafe. This is a customer-facing label/grouping change plus adding Zip.
key_patterns.blog_post_dom_order:
src/pages/post/[slug].tsx renders inside
: category -> h1 -> byline -> .content ->
(gated on post.tags.length) ->
-> newer/older pager -> related cards. The CONTRIBUTION block goes AFTER the tags
and BEFORE the .post-share div. shareRef is the IntersectionObserver sentinel for the reveal effect; inserting a block before it does not change that (the effect finds .post-share by ref). The post page owns its own and qualifies as public via isContentPublic (not PUBLIC_PAGE_META).
key_patterns.central_amount_config_precedent: src/config/share.ts is the precedent for a single central config module imported where needed, with a test (ShareMeta.test.tsx) holding duplicate literals equal. Section 5 contribution preset amounts (49, 99, 199 rupees + Other) must live in ONE config module (e.g. src/config/contribution.ts) and the server must also know the allowed/validated amount range authoritatively - the browser never controls the trusted amount.
key_patterns.paise_calculator: amplify/functions/shared/lambda_utils/ecommerce/checkout_pricing.py is the exact Decimal/integer-paise calculator (QuoteSnapshot, round_half_up, 2.5% convenience fee + 18% GST-on-fee, the 121481-paise fixture in tests/test_checkout_pricing.py). amplify/functions/shared/lambda_utils/ecommerce/money.py has Money/positive_paise. Reuse these; never use float; reject fractional paise.
key_patterns.payment_gate: amplify/functions/ecommerce/checkout/handler.py reads CHECKOUT_INITIATION_ENABLED (env, default OFF) ~line 123 and returns PAYMENT_INITIATION_DISABLED when off; website_checkout.prepare_checkout (lambda_utils/ecommerce/website_checkout.py) does the same with its own CHECKOUT_INITIATION_ENABLED gate. Readiness also requires EXPECTED_CONFIGURATION_NAME/EXPECTED_PROVIDER_MID (empty => not ready). NO constant may force payment on. Any new payable path (gift-card redemption, blog contribution) MUST sit behind this SAME disabled gate / an equivalent server-enforced readiness gate, build full server-side verify/idempotency/reconciliation + tests, but stay un-live.
key_patterns.verify_and_webhook_patterns_to_reuse: integrations/razorpay_orders.py (create_order, account_mode test/live/unknown), integrations/razorpay_verify.py (authoritative captured-payment readback), payments/razorpay-webhook/handler.py (HMAC-verified events, idempotency log, quarantine of paid-but-blocked captures, single-settlement, the partner_billing.topup pattern where payment.notes are NEVER the authority - who/how-much is re-derived and an idempotency claim keyed by payment id is conditional). ecommerce/order_keys.py mints/reserves references under PAYREF#, binds gateway orders, reserves request keys, records capture quarantine, and has one-time conditional claims. ecommerce/payment_attempt.py is the attempt state machine. The BLOG_CONTRIBUTION flow must reuse these: server-side verify + provider readback + webhook + idempotency + integer paise; never trust query strings, browser callbacks, frontend state, or a bare Razorpay signature as payment proof.
key_patterns.giftcard_rejection: cart_v2.CartV2.calculate currently RAISES CartContractError on any paymentSummary.giftCards / split / deferred payment (lines ~132-141), and requires payNow==totalAfterGiftCards==total. Do NOT simply delete that protection. Implement the authoritative replacement: authoritative Wix total - verified gift-card redemption = Razorpay payable (integer paise), with full edge cases, gated off. Model the gift-card/coupon authority as server-side/Wix-authoritative behind an abstracted provider seam (bind concrete provider later). Never hard-code a third-party gift-card vendor; never surface 'Gift Up'/'GiftUp'/any third-party provider name in customer-facing UI.
key_patterns.giftcard_url_audit: /gift-card is referenced today but NO page exists at that route (it 404s). Active references: amplify/functions/messaging/inbound-whatsapp-handler/handler.py (two CTAs to https://wecare.digital/gift-card), amplify/functions/ai/ai-generate-response/handler.py (store_gift_card CTA), amplify/functions/operations/seo-tools/wix.py (/gift-card entry), plus docs and workspace display pages (src/pages/workspace/dashboard/system-architecture.tsx, workspace/engage/whatsapp/scripts.tsx describe the CTA). Create/repair a real public destination (Perks Gift Cards page at /perks/ or a /gift-card route or /perks/gift-cards) and update ACTIVE customer-facing links; do NOT break workspace display references or edit Meta-approved historical ids.
